closing.reason: The round-2 check (lock the schema-qualified name, then to_regclass(name) = p_child under the lock) rests on 'a rename takes ACCESS EXCLUSIVE, which the held lock conflicts with'. That covers ALTER TABLE RENAME but not ALTER SCHEMA RENAME, which takes no relation lock. V-01 (Tier 3, deterministic, in READ COMMITTED): the partition's schema is swapped with one holding a partitioned table S of the same name while the call waits, so LOCK TABLE re-resolves the name onto S, then recurses into S's partition and waits there; meanwhile the schemas are swapped back, so the check sees the name denote p_child and passes with no lock on p_child; the row is recorded, a DETACH of p_child commits before the call's transaction (detach succeeds, no 55P03), and pgpm.part records a standalone table at commit, the #1262 consequence, against body guarantee (2). It fails identically on the head, the base and the adopt_partition_lock_name_unchecked mutant (assertions 6 and 8, every LIVENESS passes), so it is pre_existing inside the PR's surface. What held: the asked attacks all refuse on the head: two renames in a row (squatter renamed again and a second squatter created, the squatter a partition of another parent q): refused, nothing recorded; the parent table renamed into the partition's name (LOCK on a partitioned table recurses into p_child): refused; a rename back after the squat cannot reach the check with the lock on the squatter, because the squatter is held SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE and LOCK TABLE re-resolves at grant (no table-rename gap); a DETACH between the check and the row's commit waits and times out 55P03 (ACC-03 verified, assertion 8). Isolation refusal: sound (transaction_isolation, not the default; READ UNCOMMITTED is RC). Other entry points: nothing in pgpm calls adopt_partition; the archive and hypertable modules have no copy; other by-name locks in install.sql (10911, 11059, 11876, 12306) are on parents and outside this bullet. Mutations: adopt_partition_strict_isolation_admitted alone restores F4-03/F11-03 (ACC-01 fails); adopt_partition_lock_name_unchecked alone restores round 1's V-01 (ACC-03 verified fails), each puts back its own defect. ACC-03: premise_removed shape confirmed (its LIVENESS step 3 needs the call to record the row; on the head the call refuses, so its defect checks lose their premise); rebuilt as claims/ACC/ACC-03/repro.verified.sql pinning the contract (refuses naming v1_x_old, nothing recorded, no adoption logged, the remedy as typed records it, a DETACH meanwhile gets 55P03, after commit recorded by oid and attached with rows 950,960). Results: base FAILS (6 of 9: assertions 4-9, no LIVENESS), head PASSES 9 of 9, mutant adopt_partition_lock_name_unchecked FAILS (6 of 9: 4-9, no LIVENESS). No open issue names a schema rename against adopt_partition's lock (#1057 is capture's rename race, #768 resolution by name in other functions).
